summary: Comprehensive Phase-2 E2E testing on FreightOS demo (frontend-only, 1440x900 primary; also 1280/1920 for map overlap). Tested JRN-26 through JRN-43 plus marker/city-label collision guard. 17 of 18 Phase-2 journeys PASS. One concern: at every viewport (1280/1440/1920) truck-marker bounding boxes still mathematically overlap one city-label bounding box each (101↔Los Angeles, 102↔Fresno, 103↔Sacramento, 104↔San Jose). Visually the pills are placed above the city dots and look acceptable, but the task explicitly asked for 'bounding boxes must not overlap'. Everything else (Schedule view with all expected blocks, Truck-102 exception resolution end-to-end including Ben Ortiz acknowledgement and delay history, Advance time + POD panel + 'No more scheduled events', revised terms v2 with $1,150/$376/+$1,096 and final KPIs $4,850/$2,150/4.7%, written-terms-differ guard with terms-reviewed-button + disabled approve, feedback classifier (fact / rule / one-off) with correction log + rule in AI instructions, Truck 104 search progress in activity panel, Reset demo restoring 10:00 + alerts + 0 rules) is working as specified.

ui_bugs.issue: Truck-marker bounding boxes overlap one city-label bounding box each at ALL tested viewports (1280/1440/1920): truck-marker-101 ↔ city-label-los-angeles, truck-marker-102 ↔ city-label-fresno, truck-marker-103 ↔ city-label-sacramento, truck-marker-104 ↔ city-label-san-jose. Visually the pills sit above/beside the city dots and look OK, but programmatic BB test fails. Review whether the testid wraps both pin and label pill (likely cause).

action_items: Resolve truck-marker vs city-label bounding-box overlap at 1280/1440/1920. Likely cause: the [data-testid='truck-marker-*'] element wraps both the pin at the city dot AND the label pill. Either (a) move the 101/102/103/104 pills further above the dot, (b) move city labels below the dot, or (c) narrow the truck-marker test boundary to just the pill so BB test passes. Specifically 101↔LA, 102↔Fresno, 103↔Sacramento, 104↔San Jose. Visually acceptable today, but programmatic BB test still fails per the Phase-1→Phase-2 fix request.
critical_code_review_comments: Idempotency on exception resolution appears to be via UI-element-replacement rather than service-level guard (same pattern as Phase-1 approve). Add a transition guard keyed on loadId+action in engine2.js/phase2Services.js for defense in depth.
Target-rate input testid is 'changes-target-rate-input' (not 'target-rate-input' as some journey text suggests) — align either doc or testid.
Delay-history timestamps look great; good extracted-facts panel after call.
Written-terms-differ: terms-reviewed-button is correctly separated from terms-differ-warning and disables approve-request-confirmation-button — clean implementation.
